historical_record.description: A commercial building then on the site, held by the Redevelopment Agency for the Performing Arts Center garage, was used for the time being by a non-profit service organisation.

Three vacant apartment buildings then on the site, held by the Redevelopment Agency for the proposed Performing Arts Center garage, were boarded up and uninhabitable from code violations and fire damage.

The City Planning Commission voted 4 to 1 to urge the Redevelopment Agency not to demolish the three vacant apartment buildings on Grove Street, 62 units in all, until rehabilitating them for housing had been shown infeasible (Resolution 7716).

The City Planning Commission voted 5 to 2 that a 600-space Parking Authority garage for the Performing Arts Center on the block conformed to the Master Plan, if rates discouraged all-day parking, and sent with its report its earlier plea (Resolution 7716) to save the apartment buildings on the site.
